title: Data Platform Manager
description:
Data Platform Manager: Newcastle upon Tyne (Hybrid): £83,000

We're partnering with a global professional services organisation undergoing significant investment in its data and analytics capabilities. Operating across multiple international locations, the business supports large enterprise clients and is driving a number of strategic data, reporting and AI initiatives.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a business-critical data platform, shaping its future direction while leading a team responsible for delivering reliable, scalable and secure data solutions.
The Role
You'll be responsible for the strategy, development and operational management of the organisation's enterprise data platform, ensuring it supports current and future business needs.

Key Responsibilities
* Own and manage the enterprise data platform roadmap
* Lead, mentor and develop the platform team
* Oversee data ingestion, transformation, storage and reporting processes
* Support analytics, data science, AI and machine learning initiatives
* Ensure data quality, governance, security and compliance standards are maintained
* Monitor platform performance, reliability and cost optimisation
* Manage platform upgrades, releases and third-party suppliers
* Partner with senior business and technical stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions

What We're Looking For
* Experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms
* Strong knowledge of Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Azure
* Understanding of Lakehouse architecture, data engineering and modern data platforms
* Experience with data governance, RBAC, security and platform operations
* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD and release management
* Previous team leadership experience
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

Why Apply?
* Take ownership of a strategic data platform
* Play a key role in a growing data and AI function
* Join a well-established international organisation
* Work on modern cloud-based technologies
* High-visibility role with genuine influence across the business

The team is interviewing this week and keen to move quickly for the right candidate so do not waste time, apply today!
